title: Chrome Halo Decay
description: A high, metallic supersaw pad built from a detuned ladder-filtered cluster that swells open then slowly corrodes: crush and coarse ramp up across the loop while resonance and a band-pass sweep give it a singing chrome formant. Over 32 cycles the airy halo degrades into a gritty alien artifact and resets.
code:
setcpm(116/4)
stack(
  note("<a5 [a5 c6] e6 <d6 g6>>/4").s("supersaw")
    .detune(sine.slow(19).range(0.2, 0.9)).unison(5)
    .lpf(sine.slow(32).range(900, 6500)).resonance(sine.slow(23).range(8, 19)).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(sine.slow(17).range(1, 5)).lpattack(0.4).lpdecay(0.9)
    .bpf(saw.slow(29).range(1800, 7200)).bpq(6)
    .crush(saw.slow(16).range(16, 5)).coarse(saw.slow(13).range(1, 6))
    .attack(1.2).decay(0.6).sustain(0.7).release(2.5)
    .pan(sine.slow(11).range(0.2, 0.8))
    .off(0.02, x => x.add(note(0.15)).gain(0.35))
    .room(0.7).delay("0.4:0.5:0.6").gain(0.7)
)
